blocks.text: Balanced tree aisa tree data structure hai jis ki height (unchai) jitni ho sake kam rakhi jati hai, aur tree ko balanced rakha jata hai. Is ke liye kisi bhi node ki baen (left) aur daen (right) subtree (shaakh) ki height mein farq ek khaas had se zyada nahi hone diya jata; aam taur par yeh had 1 hoti hai. Balanced trees se searching (dhoondna), insertion (dalna) aur deletion (nikalna) tez hote hain, kyunke in kaamon ka waqt O(log n) ke qareeb rehta hai, yaani items barhne par bhi qadam bohat kam barhte hain.
Misal: library mein kitabein tarteeb dena

Sochiye ek library ko kitabein shelves par achhi tarah rakhni aur dhoondni hain. Agar saari kitabein ek hi shelf par seedhi line mein hon to kisi khaas kitab ke liye bohat si kitabein dekhni par sakti hain. Is ki bajaye kitabon ko balanced tree ki shakal mein tarteeb dein.

Tree ki root (jarr) par ek bari category hai, jaise Science. Is ke neeche subcategories Physics aur Biology hain, jo root ke children hain. Har subcategory aur hisson mein bat'ti hai: Physics ke neeche Classical Mechanics aur Quantum Physics, aur Biology ke neeche Botany aur Zoology. Yeh silsila aise chalta hai ke koi shaakh baqi shaakhon se bohat lambi na ho.

Is balanced tree mein Quantum Physics ki kitab dhoondne ke liye shaakhon par neeche jate hain: pehle Science, phir Physics, phir Quantum Physics. Tree balanced hai, is liye us ki height categories ki tadaad ke logarithm jitni rehti hai aur talash jaldi ho jati hai.

Kitab ki Figure 4.7 ek darakht ki tasveer hai jis ki shaakhon par kitabon ki qismein likhi hain (book shop). Computer science ka tree is ka ulta hota hai: root oopar aur shaakhein neeche, jaisa Figure 4.8 mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Balanced tree mein talash, lambi zanjeer (chain) ban jane wale tree se tez kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Balanced tree mein root se kisi bhi node tak taqreeban log n qadam hain; zanjeer jaise tree mein n qadam tak lag sakte hain, bilkul list mein ek ek kar ke dhoondne ki tarah.
